title: Juicy Jicama Mexican Chicken Enchiladas
description: Grassy, snappy, and energizing Yucatecan-style enchiladas made with juicy chicken drumsticks, crunchy jicama slaw, and a hint of citrus. This paleo-friendly recipe is perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the lime juice, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. Add the chicken drumsticks and toss to coat.
Let the chicken marinate for 15 minutes.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Remove the chicken from the marinade and cook until browned on both sides and cooked through, about 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and grate the jicamas and transfer to a bowl. Squeeze the lime juice over the jicama and toss to coat.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.

To assemble the enchiladas, lay a tortilla flat and spoon some of the shredded chicken in the center. Roll the tortilla and place seam-side down in the tagine pot. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and chicken.
Pour the jicama slaw over the top of the enchiladas and sprinkle with chopped cilantro and scallions.
Cover the tagine pot with a lid and bake for 15 minutes, or until the tortillas are crispy and the filling is heated through.
